nosotros_row1_p1: We are a group of international companies and institutions with extensive experience (between 15 and more than 60 years) that research, develop, and manufacture equipment and software in the fields of information technology and biometrics.
nosotros_row1_p2: Our work covers the entire cycle of electronic equipment design and development, from the product idea, providing support from the specification phase to turnkey delivery.
nosotros_row1_p3: Our professionals are experts in electronic hardware design, embedded software design, and user/server interface software design.
nosotros_row2_p1: We deliver turnkey products according to each client's specific requirements.
nosotros_row2_p2: Our embedded systems designs include programmable logic systems, low-power battery-powered microcontroller-based systems, and real-time systems based on next-generation microprocessors.
nosotros_row2_p3: We operate in Latin America, Europe, and North America, offering solutions for the aerospace, agricultural, industrial, automotive, medical, banking, and security sectors.
